title: The Secret Herb: How Kratom Can Improve Your Daily Well-being
htmlContent:
It isn’t easy to imagine that only a few years ago, kratom was mainly featured as a footnote in wellness discussions. Today, this herb dominates many conversations on alternative medicine. For the uninitiated, kratom (known botanically as Mitragyna speciosa) is a tropical evergreen tree from Southeast Asia that’s widely marketed for its diverse pharmaceutical abilities. The plant is indigenous to the lush rainforests of Thailand, Indonesia, and Malaysia. Anecdotal reports and clinical trials suggest that kratom might remedy several ailments, which explains why its popularity now stretches far beyond its original native range. Additional findings indicate that the herb may be used synergistically with or as a replacement for various conventional medications. That’s due to its relatively higher safety profile than most prescription drugs. In this post, we examine how kratom may improve your daily well-being.

1. Kratom May Help With Pain Management

Pain is the most debilitating medical condition, affecting millions worldwide. According to conservative estimates, the global chronic pain prevalence stands at 10%. It’s logical to infer that the figures are significantly higher if you also factor in acute pain. Locals in kratom’s native habitat have consumed the herb for hundreds of years to relieve pain, and several emerging studies have since corroborated those analgesic claims. In one experiment, researchers noted a remarkably higher pain tolerance for the study group that administered kratom extracts. Kratom’s analgesic properties are mainly due to its positive interactions with several opioid receptors in the brain, including the mu- and kappa-opioid receptors.

2. Kratom May Supercharge Your Energy Levels

Fatigue is a leading cause of diminished daytime productivity. It affects workplace performance, social activity, and cognitive and behavioral functioning. Without proper treatment, chronic fatigue can significantly reduce the quality of life. Mitragyna speciosa is a powerful stimulant noted for its uplifting benefits. When consumed at relatively low doses, kratom can activate your energy reserves and increase mental alertness. Again, these effects are primarily attributed to its impact on various opioid receptors. Note that kratom shares a similar botanical origin with coffee. Therefore, its effects are synonymous with caffeine’s. 3. Kratom May Optimize Your Workouts

Pain and fatigue are significant impediments to a successful workout. Since kratom may treat both conditions, it’s evident why the herb has found its way into the sports and fitness industry. Consuming kratom right before hitting the gym can provide the energy bursts you need to endure strenuous exercises. And after every workout session, you could administer the herb to relieve delayed onset of muscle soreness (DOMS). DOMS is a post-workout condition characterized by excruciating muscle pain and joint tenderness. While the condition typically resolves by itself, it can cause great discomfort while it lasts. By administering kratom, you can relieve DOMS and avert workout downtimes.

4. Kratom May Soothe Nervousness

Stressful events are part of our daily experience. However, unmanaged stress can degenerate to full-blown anxiety disorders over time. Anxiety can impair your workplace productivity and impede your ability to make meaningful connections. Worse yet, it could lead to more severe mental health problems, such as depression. Remember how kratom increases energy levels at smaller doses? Well, studies indicate that the herb might induce sedation at relatively higher amounts. According to one experiment investigating crouton's anxiolytic properties, those who self-medicated with the herb reported marked improvements in anxiety symptoms. The plant triggers mild euphoria, increasing the user’s sociability while banishing nervousness. Note that dose variation alone doesn’t determine whether kratom will stimulate your energy levels or mellow you down. There are also strains to consider. Kratom comes in dozens of strains, with the most dominant ones being red vein, white vein, and green vein. Choose the relaxing red vein strains for anxiety and the invigorating white veins for fatigue. 5. Kratom May Improve Your Sleep Quality

Can’t sleep well at night? Well, you’re not alone. Millions around the world grapple with various sleep disorders, including insomnia, sleep apnea, and REM sleep behavior disorder (RBD). But before you resort to conventional sleep pills (many of which might leave you worse off), you might want to experiment with Mitragyna speciosa extracts. As kratom may soothe nervousness, it can boost sleep quality by shortening your sleep latency. Besides, croutons' anxiolytic effects might come in handy for people with sleep-disruptive anxiety disorders, such as post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Administering the herb at bedtime may calm racing thoughts known to trigger PTSD flashbacks and nightmares. [caption id="attachment_543214" align="alignnone" width="662"] Pixabay.com[/caption]  

6. Kratom May Bring Out the Sensual Animal in You

Erectile dysfunction (ED) is a dignity-stripping condition that afflicts many. While generally considered a reproductive health issue, ED can result from secondary factors like pain and anxiety. Kratom may treat erectile dysfunction by alleviating intercourse pain and performance anxiety. The herb also improves mental alertness, allowing sexual partners to immerse themselves fully in the moment. Kratom is a potent vasodilator, too. The plant’s natural alkaloids can dilate constricted blood vessels, ramping blood circulation to various body parts. Increased blood supply to the sexual organs can lead to stronger and long-lasting erections. One survey was commissioned to investigate kratom’s effects on sexual performance. In the end, up to 85% of respondents who administered kratom extracts reported increased sexual desire.

7. Kratom May Help With Opioid Withdrawal

The opioid crisis in North America has claimed thousands of lives in recent years. And with no signs of abating, addressing the epidemic may call for a multi-pronged approach involving law enforcement and alternative medicine. Many kratom proponents suggest the herb may ease the opioid crisis. These assertions derive from the fact that kratom impacts similar opioid receptors as conventional opioid drugs, but in a less dramatic manner. Scheduled opioids like fentanyl exert their full influence on opioid receptors, leading to acute addiction and dependency. Conversely, kratom alkaloids partially impact opioid receptors. As a partial opioid agonist, kratom poses fewer risks of addiction. One study found that the risks of overdose are over 1,000 times greater for regular opioids than kratom, lending credence to kratom’s safety. Moreover, opioid users can switch to kratom without worrying about experiencing severe adverse events. That’s because kratom can alleviate several opioid withdrawal symptoms, including headaches, muscle aches, drowsiness, and nervousness. Summary

Kratom can provide numerous therapeutic benefits without inducing worrying adverse effects. Even if unpleasant reactions occur, they’re typically mild and short-lasting. However, it’s imperative to underscore the significance of moderation while administering kratom for the first time. Although this plant is undeniably safer than many prescription meds, an overdose might trigger nasty adverse events. Another good practice is to consult a licensed medical doctor or naturopath before adding kratom to your wellness regimen. This is particularly recommended if you’re presently on ongoing treatment for certain chronic illnesses.
